neighbours.label: A bracket-plus-newline token (' [\n', ' {\n') opening a multi-line literal in indented Python; the same literal written on one line, and an unindented multi-line literal, stay quiet.

short: bracket + newline opening a multi-line literal
notes:
Probes: 0.28-0.60 in indented multi-line code; one-liners 0.02-0.03; unindented multi-line 0.02-0.04, with the bracket token not the peak. But `compute_totals(
` read 0.03 and a nested `data={'rule': {
` 0.06, so not all such tokens fire, even though the card's most common is '(
'. Fire items are multi-line passages.
